Paan Singh Tomar is based on a true story of an athlete of the same name. While working in the army he surprised his seniors with his athletic ability. He wasn’t interested in sports but he soon joined in as there were no restrictions on their diet. He participated in Indian National Games and won a gold medal in steeplechase event for seven consecutive years. Paan's brother informed him that their property was being taken over by Bhanwar Singh, a relative. He returned to his village to settle the dispute but no one came forward to help him. Bhanwar and his men attacked Paan's family but everyone managed to escape except for his mother who died in the attack. He formed a gang with his family members to avenge his mother’s death. He planned an attack on Bhanwar and killed him. To avenge his brother’s death Paan killed 9 villagers who had become police informers. A reporter interviewed Paan and told him all about the aforementioned events. Following the interview, police look for Paan. His family and former coach ask him to surrender to which he refused. One of the gang members became police informer and leaked their hideout place.
